description: Leave-one-feature-out ablation around the P3-T2 C3 baseline. The baseline is the full 14-feature condition; each ablation removes exactly one feature and keeps the other thirteen, using the same cached frames, graph, mapping, simulation seed, initial conditions, duration and timestep as P3-T2.

full-input.description: full 14-feature input; must reproduce the archived P3-T2 C3 reference

units.step_current_pa: instantaneous population current in pA delivered during one 0.5 ms step
units.injected_pa_steps: neuron-step exposure: instantaneous pA summed over neurons and steps; multiply by dt_ms to convert to pA·ms

contrasts_vs_baseline.note: Whole-condition contrasts of a deterministic recurrent network; descriptive only, not additive contributions.

limitations: Removing a feature measures necessity within this schedule; it does not
establish that the feature is sufficient to cause ignition.
Reduced recurrent activity is not automatically better behaviour.
Network ignition is not sensory routing; downstream spikes are not proof
Structural connectivity is not physiological validation; no biological
action_selection: none; the chain ends at sensory current injection
